description: The file defines an ImpactDiscoverController class which handles various pages and API endpoints related to impact discovery features in a web application. It includes methods for setting context, processing query parameters, and rendering different views such as index, map, mosaic, and data sets, all pertaining to project impact data.

classes.name: ImpactDiscoverController
classes.description: A controller handling impact discovery pages and API endpoints within the application, including listing projects, maps, mosaics, and datasets based on impact-related filters.

methods.name: setImpactDiscoverContext
methods.description: Sets the context variables like footprints, SDGs, and channels for use in views.

methods.name: getQueryParameters
methods.description: Extracts and sanitizes filter parameters from the HTTP request query string.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles the main impact discovery page, listing projects based on filters.

methods.name: mapAction
methods.description: Renders a map view of projects based on impact filters.

methods.name: mosaicAction
methods.description: Displays projects in a mosaic layout filtered by impact data.

methods.name: dataSetsAction
methods.description: Provides dataset information related to impact filters.
